title: The Cellar of Kindness
tagline: A cozy all-ages run under Dad's favorite tavern.

rooms.title: The Creaky Hatch
rooms.narration: A wooden hatch leads down into a warm cellar that smells like cinnamon and old stories. Cobwebs sparkle like fairy lights. Your party gathers at the top of the stairs.

options.label: March in bravely (banter)
options.successText: You stamp down the stairs together, trading jokes. The hatch thumps shut behind you—friendly, somehow.

options.label: Tip-toe carefully (check: Care)
options.successText: Soft steps. No squeaks. The cellar welcomes you like a secret clubhouse.
options.failText: A step squeaks loudly—everyone freezes, then laughs. You still make it down. Fail-forward!

rooms.title: The Glow-Chest Nook
rooms.narration: A small chest sits on a barrel, glowing gold. A note reads: 'For brave friends—share what you find.'

action.prompt: What do you do with the chest?

options.label: Open it together (loot)
options.successText: Inside: sticky toffee coins and a map scrap. Everyone gets a shiny souvenir.

options.label: Study the rune lock (check: Wit)
options.successText: The rune clicks open. Bonus: a tiny brass dad-joke whistle.
options.failText: The lock shrugs and pops open anyway. You get the toffee coins—plus a mild sticky-finger curse that wears off in one room.

rooms.title: The Tickle-Tile Hall
rooms.narration: The floor tiles look suspicious. One is painted with a smiling boot. Dad's voice echoes from upstairs: 'Watch your step!'

options.label: Hop the safe tiles (check: Grit)
options.successText: Perfect hops. The tickle trap stays asleep. You high-five mid-air.
options.failText: A tile giggles and sprays harmless glitter foam. You're damp, sparkling, and still across the hall.

options.label: Prod with a broom pole (trap)
options.successText: Foam sprays the broom, not you. Clever—and very sticky. Onward!

rooms.title: The Mirror of Mild Bragging
rooms.narration: A tall mirror shows each of you looking slightly more heroic than usual. It asks for one kind brag about a teammate.

options.label: Cheer a teammate (banter)
options.successText: The mirror sparkles. Confidence +1 (flavor). The cellar feels brighter.

options.label: Answer the mirror's riddle (check: Wit)
options.successText: You nail it: 'What has keys but opens no doors? A dad joke piano!' The mirror bows.
options.failText: Wrong answer—but the mirror laughs kindly and waves you on. Fail-forward with warm applause.

rooms.title: The Grumpy Barrel King
rooms.narration: A big barrel with stick-on googly eyes blocks the stair back up. It growls: 'Nobody leaves without a hug... I mean, a card challenge!' Play allies from your party hand — spend Energy each turn.

action.prompt: Card combat — play allies, then End turn to resolve hits

combat.prompt: Card combat — play allies, then End turn to resolve hits

ending.title: Back to the Tavern
ending.blurb: You climb into warm lantern light. Dad applauds. The cellar of kindness is cleared—and the sticky toffee tastes like victory.
